output.summary: Turnover rise is real (payroll-reconciled, so not a migration artifact) and far exceeds in-state peers (+19 vs +5 points). The monthly series steps up in March 2026, when the all-branch Saturday policy took effect, before ShiftWise went live in April. Schedule-related exits rose from 19% to 48% of survey reasons, while the pay share stayed flat. That supports the Saturday link as causal. Whether pay is below market, whether ShiftWise adds harm, and whether turnover concentrates under weak managers are all unestablished. No branch data exists, and the manager-of-record field is stale. Do not approve the irreversible 15% raise or punish managers now. Get the branch-level report, the ShiftWise comparison and a market benchmark. A targeted mid-year adjustment remains possible.
